name: Journey to the Marsh
summary: Your class sends you to Dustwallow Marsh, where Tabetha’s knowledge can help you earn your wand.

sections.title: Tabetha’s Cottage
sections.body: West of Theramore and just north of the Stonemaul Ruins, Tabetha lives in a cottage. Your class asks you to speak with the hermit and learn from her vast knowledge.

faq.answer: Tabetha is a hermit in Dustwallow Marsh, known for her vast knowledge.
Tabetha’s cottage is west of Theramore and just north of the Stonemaul Ruins.

faq.q: Why am I being sent to Tabetha?
faq.answer: Speaking with Tabetha begins your effort to earn your class’s wand.

attribution: In-game quest text: Journey to the Marsh
